props.source:
Description:

This Action will create a software version for all of the existing Configuration DB which will include:

  • DB Schema
  • All created tables
  • All the data for configured functions
  • It will not include any data in the TransactionsLog Table

The software version will be appended to a project script which can later be used to restore the project.

config.script:
import time
	username=self.session.props.auth.user.userName
	APIConfigDB=self.parent.parent.parent.parent.getChild("DB_Selection").getChild("FlexContainer").getChild("Selections").getChild("APIConfigDB").props.value
	selectedSoftware_version=self.parent.parent.getChild("Count").getChild("Table").getChild("Dropdown").props.value
	dbstatus=self.session.custom.dbstatus


	
	if dbstatus=="Valid":
		messageboxparams={"data":{"icon": "",
				  "title": "Please Wait",
				  "level": "info",
				  "message": "Rebuilding the Project from : {0}. Please wait.".format(selectedSoftware_version)
				  }
				  }
							  
		system.perspective.openPopup("loading", "API_Screens/Pop_Ups/Loading_Box",messageboxparams, showCloseIcon=False, draggable=False, resizable=False, modal=True, overlayDismiss=True)
		rebuild_call=API.Build_SQL.Functions.rebuild_from_Software_Version(APIConfigDB, getattr(API.Build_SQL.Software_Versions,selectedSoftware_version))

		#system.project.requestScan()
		system.perspective.closePopup("loading")
		system.perspective.sendMessage("tablerefresh")
	
		messageboxparams["data"]["title"]= "Rebuilt Completed"
		messageboxparams["data"]["level"]= "popup"
		messageboxparams["data"]["message"]= rebuild_call
		

		script_path = "API.Build_SQL.Software_Versions."+selectedSoftware_version

		
		version_script = eval(script_path)
	
	
	
		##logEvent add assignet
		logparams={"username":username,
			"event_type":"Software Ver. Rebuild",
			"before_change":None,
			"after_change":version_script,
			"description":"Rebuilt from Software Version {0} ".format(selectedSoftware_version)}
		API.Functions.log_activity(logparams)
			
		system.perspective.openPopup("UpdateREsults", "API_Screens/Pop_Ups/Message_Box",messageboxparams, showCloseIcon=False, draggable=False, resizable=False, modal=True, overlayDismiss=True)
	

	else:
		
		messageboxparams["data"]["title"]= "Data-Base Connection Error"
		messageboxparams["data"]["level"]= "error"
		messageboxparams["data"]["message"]= "The database connection is not valid."
						  
		system.perspective.openPopup("dbError", "API_Screens/Pop_Ups/Message_Box",messageboxparams, showCloseIcon=False, draggable=False, resizable=False, modal=True, overlayDismiss=True)

props.source:
Description:

Once the project has at least one Software Version set, this action will complete the following steps in the Configuration DB:

  • Drop any existing tables
  • Add db Schema
  • Create Project tables
  • Insert All the data for configured functions
  • It will not include any data in the TransactionsLog Table
